data.name: Aaeedah
data.gender_notes: Aaeedah is used as a female name in Arabic and Urdu.
data.short_meaning: Returning; one who returns; benefit, advantage
data.long_meaning: Aaeedah (عائدة) is the feminine active participle of the Arabic verb ʿāda, 'to return', and means 'returning, one who returns'. The closely related noun ʿāʾid means 'benefit, advantage, that which accrues'. The name is well attested in Arabic as Ā'idah; Aaeedah is one of several transliterations.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name is understood as 'one who returns' or 'one who brings benefit'; any spiritual reading placed on it is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.etymology: Feminine active participle of Arabic ʿāda (to return); related noun ʿāʾid, benefit.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaeedah total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aaeedah mean?

faq.q: How is Aaeedah written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aaeedah is written عائدة in Arabic and عائدہ in Urdu, and आइदा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aaeedah?
faq.a: The root of Aaeedah is ع-و-د (ʿ-w-d), from ʿāʾidah (عائدة).
